name: io.github.iampopovich/testit-mcp-server
title: Test IT
description: Test IT test management for AI assistants: work items, test plans, test runs and results.

environmentVariables.name: TESTIT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Test IT instance, e.g. https://testit.example.com

environmentVariables.name: TESTIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Test IT private API token (sent as PrivateToken)

environmentVariables.name: TESTIT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only read-only tools

environmentVariables.name: TESTIT_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose (default: default; also admin, bulk, all)
